summary: NY Creates operates the Albany NanoTech Complex, the largest non-profit semiconductor R&D facility in the U.S., focusing on next-generation chip development and fabrication processes. It collaborates with universities and research institutions to drive innovation and workforce development in semiconductor manufacturing.
